title: Türkiye Summons Georgian Ambassador Over Police Violence at Beşiktaş Match in Batumi
detail: Ankara summoned Georgian Ambassador Archil Kalandia on Nov 27 over incidents involving police and Beşiktaş fans at Thursday's Europa League match against Hapoel Beer-Sheva in Batumi. Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan also raised the matter by phone with his Georgian counterpart Maka Botchorishvili.

media.caption: Türkiye summons Georgian ambassador over Batumi match incidents
